name: Word of Grievous Healing
body:
School conjuration (healing); Level bard 5, cleric/oracle 5, druid 6, inquisitor 5, shaman 5, witch 6

This spell functions like word of light healing except except that it cures 5d4 points of damage plus 1 per two caster level (maximum +12).
